description: This file defines a React component 'TraceView' for visualizing trace data in a web UI, including logic for loading trace models from files or URLs, and polling for live trace data updates.

classes.name: TraceModel
classes.description: Represents the trace data model loaded from trace files or URLs.

methods.name: loadSingleTraceFile
methods.description: Fetches and loads a trace file from a URL, returning a TraceModel instance.

methods.name: outputDirForTestCase
methods.description: Determines the output directory for a given test case by traversing its parent suites.
